isolated_vm_or_physical_power_loss.reason: Docker Desktop's Linux VM is shared with the parallel workstream; no independent disposable VM or power-cut rig was available.

actual_kernel_fsync_eio.reason: Tests inject EIO at deterministic pre-syscall boundaries; no FUSE, dm-error, or faulting filesystem was available.

commands: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:reliability

environment.host: Darwin 25.0.0 arm64, APFS, Apple M2 Max
environment.container_runtime: Docker Desktop Linux VM, overlayfs (shared; not terminated)

durable_commit_point: Complete newline-terminated journal record append followed by successful journal FileHandle.sync().
limitations: Process SIGKILL preserves the host page cache and cannot prove power-loss ordering.
Durability remains conditional on honest file and directory fsync behavior, atomic local hard-link/rename semantics, and storage hardware/controller cache guarantees.
Directory fsync errors EINVAL, ENOTSUP, and EBADF are tolerated for platform compatibility; those paths do not establish durable directory entries.

The repository had an unborn main branch with no existing commits. This branch uses an isolated orphan root snapshot; integration is via patch/cherry-pick after the shared baseline is established, not a normal merge-base merge.
